Everyone knows Jack and 18. It’s the greatest numerical association in golf: Jack Nicklaus, 18 professional men’s major victories.Nothing is bigger, in terms of achievement, in the game.The men’s professional major landscape includes the Masters Tournament, PGA Championship, U.S. Open and The Open Championship. Only six players have won them all. Only three players have won double-digits in total.In 2026, Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive green jacket, becoming just the fourth player in history to repeat at the Masters.Here’s a look at the list of men who have won at least three majors in professional golf history: Rory McIlroy hangs onto green jacket, realizing winning Masters is never easyAfter waiting 17 years for his first green jacket, McIlroy kept it on Sunday at Augusta National, though his second straight Masters victory wasn't any easier than the first.DiscoverUndo This Masters is suddenly and surprisingly no longer Rory McIlroy's victory lapOn a record Saturday of scoring at Augusta National, McIlroy fought just to keep the wheels on, losing his six-shot lead and now finding himself tied with Cameron Young entering Sunday.DiscoverUndo Seeking AlphaTop 10 Stocks for 2026Read MoreSkipUndo Rory McIlroy's career PGA Tour wins: A list of every event McIlroy has won on TourRory McIlroy collected his 30th career PGA Tour win at the Masters Tournament.
